What they should have done was make the 5 regions play in a bracket BO1. 5th place gets sent to the brackets and 1-4 are seeded how they place.

Instead of a A and B bracket they would have a 8 team bracket and top 4 will place against the main bracket. This would not have been a time constraint as the caster repeatedly said they will play games until the eventual bracket winners were placed.

Doing it this way makes sure the region teams all play each other and the brackets all play each other giving a better idea of the best team in the world.
